ios.desc:
Simplify your day. Amplify your life.

Lullkit is a toolkit for conscious tool use — micro-stacks, smart hacks and bite-size lessons for makers and digital nomads who want to get more done with less noise.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- Micro-stacks: small, proven combinations of tools and habits you can set up in minutes
- Smart hacks: one-screen tips for the apps and devices you already use
- Bite-size lessons: learn one useful thing a day, in under two minutes
- Today: one intention and a few small actions, checked off in seconds
- Saved: keep the cards you want to come back to

CALMER TECH, LIGHTER FOOTPRINT
Many actions in Lullkit also cut digital waste — streaming in HD instead of 4K, Wi-Fi over 5G, dark mode, fewer notifications. Each shows an estimated CO₂ saving so you can see small habits add up. All figures are estimates; the method and sources are explained in the app.

BUILT FOR FOCUS
No account. No ads. No tracking. Everything stays on your device. Notifications are optional and only when you ask.

FOR MAKERS AND DIGITAL NOMADS
Designers, developers, writers, founders and anyone who works from anywhere and wants their tools to work for them, not the other way round.

Simplify your day. Amplify your life.
